subject.title: AbeBooks withdrawal recovery misses live listings when mk row is absent

question: Should marketplace/data approve an AbeBooks reverse recovery that seeds only verified live `stockStatus=WITHDRAWN` book listings missing `mk_abebooks`, or require live API verification before any row rehydration?
rationale: The fix involves external marketplace state and a mass data mutation, so repository policy requires human approval of scope and proof before execution.

options.title: Dry-run seed-and-withdraw
options.body: Run a dry-run with exact count, three samples, and literal filter for the withdrawn-book subset, then seed minimal `mk_abebooks` rows and let the withdraw cron process them.

options.title: Verify every candidate live first
options.body: Add an AbeBooks live/API verification step before seeding rows, reducing false positives at the cost of more implementation and rate-limit risk.

options.title: Fold into broader orphan-row program
options.body: Route this through a multi-marketplace orphan-listing reconciliation effort with eBay/CDL/MercadoLibre instead of a provider-specific fix.

recommendation.title: Dry-run seed-and-withdraw
recommendation.body: Run a dry-run with exact count, three samples, and literal filter for the withdrawn-book subset, then seed minimal `mk_abebooks` rows and let the withdraw cron process them.

likelyOwner.reason: Javier has the strongest operational evidence trail for this AbeBooks report and recent AbeBooks withdraw logging history.
